title.text: LeTour Analytics · design v2 · real Tour de France 2025 values

changes.text:
What changed in v2 (user notes, 29 Oct)

• Overview: rider/team picker (default final top 5); E10 toggle GC rank / Cumulative time; every inflection marked and listed by stage; yellow changes numbered.
• GC: leaderboard rows multi-select (default top 5); E1 chart = overall GC standing per stage; Bonus + Penalty columns right after Gap; E4 age anchored at race start (5 Jul 2025).
• Time Trials: own page (E11) with ITT results and GC impact.
• Riders: E5 Mountain contours drill-down panel.
• Teams: E14 counts every rider (2 from one team = 2), plus Stages and Riders columns.
• Nations: E8 country selector.

All numbers come from the loaded LeTour DB. Points/KOM columns stay empty until the method is approved.
